abilities.name: Psychic Scream
abilities.note: Area fear. Fear Ward and Tremor Totem help.

tactics.general: Psychic Scream can send people into other packs. Fear Ward and Tremor Totem help, stand in a corner. Dispel Shadow Word: Pain, interrupt Mana Burn.

abilities.name: Ground Tremor
abilities.timing: when its target is 0-15 yards away, every 9-14s

tactics.general: Very easy. Earth Shock interrupts casters.
Patrols between two hound packs. Kill the pack opposite his path, then the other when he walks back, then him.
Very easy, just destroy his totem.

abilities.name: Mighty Blow
abilities.note: Knockback. Stand so you land on the platform.

tactics.general: Not hard, but don't get knocked off the platform, there is no way back up.

abilities.name: Frost Nova
abilities.timing: when its target is 0-8 yards away, every 14-18s

abilities.name: Frostbolt
abilities.timing: when its target is 0-40 yards away, every 2-4s

tactics.general: Rare, with Verek. Kill Stilgiss, then Verek.

abilities.name: Holy Strike
abilities.timing: when its target is in melee range, every 6-8s

tactics.general: Hits very hard and heals. Interrupt the heal, pre-cast heals on the tank. Undergeared groups should clear the path first.
Face him away, his splash is minor then. He spawns adds, kill them.
Warrior-like. Calls low-health adds during the fight, AoE them.

abilities.name: Chain Lightning
abilities.timing: when its target is 0-30 yards away, every 9-13s

tactics.general: Chain Lightning is the killer. Stay spread so it can't bounce.
Break the three kegs in the Grim Guzzler storeroom to spawn him. Control his adds, kill him, don't aggro the bar.

Buy six Dark Iron Ale from Plugger and give them to Private Rocknot. After three turn-ins he rages, Phalanx activates and the door breaks open. Phalanx hits hard but is easy. Don't hit the bar patrons.

abilities.name: Hamstring
abilities.timing: when its target is in melee range, every 12-15s

tactics.general: Adds run to him and buff him if they arrive. Kill them on the way, keep his stacks low.
tactics.dps: Kill adds before they reach him.

tactics.general: Chest of the Seven brother.
Two rows of golems along the hall breathe deadly fire. Pull him to a spot away from the flames, then it's easy.
tactics.tank: Place him out of the golem flames.

tactics.general: Save Moira for the quest or kill her too. To save her, keep her busy with an off-tank or interrupts (she heals and hits him back up); she turns friendly when he dies. To kill her, burn her first.
Interrupt her heals and spells. Burn her first if you want her loot.
Ring of the Law option. Whirlwind and Mortal Strike, heal hard between Mortal Strikes.
Ring of the Law option. Easy, but hits hard after his enrage.

Ring of the Law option, the hardest. Mage-like: dispel Polymorph, everyone at range for Arcane Explosion.
Ring of the Law option. Dispel Curse of Tongues and Enveloping Web right away.
